channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Musk urges top AI labs, Chinese companies to test each other's models amid calls for slowdown
item.description: Elon Musk called for the leading AI labs to peer review each others' models before they're released to the public as a way to evaluate their safety.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007 as traders bet a Fed rate hike is coming
item.description: The sell-off in U.S. government debt is deepening as investors price in an interest rate hike this week.

item.title: Trump calls Supreme Court mail ballot ruling 'big loss for Republicans'
item.description: President Trump blasted his three Supreme Court appointees for blocking a Postal Service rule that would have allowed mail-in ballots in November's elections.

item.title: Dow falls more than 500 points as losses accelerate following a 19-year high in the 10-year Treasury yield: Live updates
item.description: The major averages closed lower on Monday as higher bond yields and oil prices kept the market under pressure.

item.title: No one and done: The Fed will hike at least two times over the next year, according to CNBC survey
item.description: While higher oil is cited as a main reason for the change in view, roughly three-quarters of respondents see the inflation problem as broader than just energy prices.

item.title: Here's what 5% bond yields mean for the stock market — and which stocks to buy
item.description: Rising bond yields make the path for stocks shakier, but they won't derail the bull market, according to Wall Street analysts.

item.title: Iranian foreign minister will head to China for talks, as Pentagon reveals financial cost of war
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi will visit China on Wednesday for talks, Beijing's foreign ministry announced on Tuesday.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Bessent defends Trump economic record in contentious hearing
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is facing questions on rising energy prices, government debt and the Trump team's economic agenda.

item.title: Nike co-founder Phil Knight to donate $1.1 billion to Oregon medical center
item.description: The gift to Providence St. Vincent Medical Center will support the creation of an all-women’s hospital as well as advance cardiovascular care across Oregon.

item.title: Treasury yields are hovering above a critical threshold. Here's what it means for stocks
item.description: Stocks sold off on Tuesday as the yield on the 10-year Treasury broke above 5%.

item.title: GM launching new customer software experience with redesigned Chevy, GMC pickups
item.description: The new system comes as vehicles are becoming more digital, leading GM to also redesign its organizational processes.

item.title: U.S. confirms for first time it has weapons deployed in space
item.description: U.S. Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said Monday that the U.S. has "on-orbit space control weapons," as he outlined a broader push to modernize the Air Force.

item.title: Oil and Treasury yields haven’t moved this closely in seven years. That’s bad news for markets
item.description: Oil and 10-year Treasury yields are moving in near lockstep, with their correlation at its strongest since 2019.

item.title: Santoli: The youthful phase of AI is over. What it means for investors
item.description: The AI narrative has flipped to a focus on the risk with the tech unpopular with the public and projections of order backlogs beyond a few quarters now suspect.

item.title: Former highflier Palantir is a bargain compared to AI-linked software peers, UBS says
item.description: Trading at relatively cheap levels, Palantir is likely to rally as outsized demand for its services keeps fueling growth, according to the Wall Street bank.

item.title: Counting the votes: Warsh faces a tough battle as the Fed girds for expected interest rate hike
item.description: Traders were pricing in a better than 92% probability of a rate increase, as well as a more than 75% chance for another one in December.

item.title: Kraft Heinz bets on more flavors for Philadelphia cream cheese as it looks to revive brands
item.description: Philadelphia will release more cream cheese flavors as part of Kraft Heinz's turnaround.

item.title: Children's clothing retailer Carter's is rebranding to appeal to a new generation of parents
item.description: Children's clothing brand Carter's is announcing a rebrand as it tries to keep up with the modern parent and its core customer base.

item.title: Oil’s safety net is fraying as Saudi Arabia races to restart a key pipeline
item.description: Analysts warn oil prices could rally sharply if the pipeline remains offline beyond an estimated five-to-seven-day inventory cushion.

item.title: U.S. auto market predictions for 2030: More hybrids, no Chinese entrants
item.description: Despite growing speculation that it won't be long until Chinese autos are sold in the U.S., John Murphy doesn't expect that to happen by 2030.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Tuesday
item.description: We're headed for a slightly lower open today.

item.title: The best credit counseling services of September 2026
item.description: A credit counseling service can develop a debt management plan that lowers your credit card interest rates and get late fees waived.

item.title: Airfares, gas and hotel prices were up this summer—Americans traveled anyway
item.description: If the fall travel season looks anything like the summer, costs for flights, hotels and gas will be higher and Americans will still find money for vacations.

item.title: Potential AI slowdown is not ‘end of the world’ for data center real estate, says Digital Realty CEO
item.description: Digital Realty and Equinix, two of the largest data center REITs, saw their stocks slump after warnings over AI advancements.

item.title: U.S. seeks to seize $61 million of crypto it claims are proceeds from Iranian petroleum sales to Chinese buyers
item.description: Two Chinese companies, are alleged to have used trading accounts in Binance to launder the illicit proceeds and funnel the funds to Tehran or its proxies.

item.title: What to expect from stocks and bonds if interest rates remain higher for longer, according to investing pros
item.description: Higher interest rates are typically viewed as dicey for stocks but also mean you can earn more on your fixed income investments.

item.title: Wall Street weighs prospect of an AI slowdown on data center buildout
item.description: Investors see a potential AI slowdown as problematic for companies tied to the data center buildout.

item.title: Warren to rip Clarity Act on Senate floor ahead of key preliminary vote
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren will call the latest Clarity Act ethics proposal blessed by Trump a "weak fig leaf."

item.title: Bank of America expects third-quarter investment banking fees to fall more than 10%; shares slide
item.description: The muted outlook from the country's second-largest bank by assets could be an early signal that Wall Street's AI boom might have hit turbulence.

item.title: Warsh's credibility is on the line this week as Trump policies put pressure on Fed to hike
item.description: With inflation above target and no visibility on lower oil prices or stability of tariffs, the Fed chairman needs to pass the test that has faced his predecessors
